verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["is amended"],"text":"Executive Order 10431 of January 19, 1953, is amended as follows:"},{"char_end":1627,"char_start":1080,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":1627,"context_char_start":1080,"line":18,"pdf_page":1,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["is amended"],"text":"(a) Section 2 is amended to read as follows: ‘‘The National Security \nMedal may be awarded to any person, without regard to nationality, including \nmembers of the Armed Forces of the United States, for distinguished achieve-\nment or outstanding contribution made on or after July 26, 1947, in the \nfield of national security through either exceptionally meritorious service \nperformed in a position of high responsibility or through an act of heroism \nrequiring personal courage of a high degree and complete disregard of per-\nsonal safety.’’; and"},{"char_end":2308,"char_start":2037,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":2308,"context_char_start":2037,"line":32,"pdf_page":1,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"Any recommendations shall be made with the concurrence of the department \nor agency employing the proposed recipient, if appropriate, and be accom-\npanied by complete documentation, including, where necessary, certificates, \naffidavits, or sworn transcripts of testimony."},{"char_end":2600,"char_start":2309,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":2600,"context_char_start":2309,"line":35,"pdf_page":1,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"Each recommendation for an \naward shall show the exact status, at the time of the rendition of the \nservice on which the recommendation is based, with respect to citizenship, \nemployment, and all other material factors of the person who is being \nrecommended for the National Security Medal."},{"char_end":2732,"char_start":2601,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":2732,"context_char_start":2601,"line":39,"pdf_page":1,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"Each recommendation shall \ncontain a draft of an appropriate citation to accompany the award of the \nNational Security Medal. \n‘‘8."},{"char_end":3224,"char_start":2733,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":3224,"context_char_start":2733,"line":42,"pdf_page":1,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"Upon a determination by the Executive Secretary of the National \nSecurity Council that the National Security Medal is warranted, and following \napproval by the President, the Executive Secretary shall notify the Office \nof the Director of National Intelligence, which will then process the award \nrecommendation, prepare the National Security Medal, with any appropriate \ndevices, and deliver the National Security Medal to the National Security \nCouncil for presentation to the recipient.’’"},{"char_end":3763,"char_start":3451,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":3763,"context_char_start":3451,"line":52,"pdf_page":1,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"(a) Nothing in this order shall be construed \nto impair or otherwise affect: \n(i) the authority granted by law to an executive department, agency, or \nthe head thereof; or \n(ii) the functions of the Director of the Office of Management and Budget \nrelating to budgetary, administrative, or legislative proposals."},{"char_end":3883,"char_start":3765,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":3883,"context_char_start":3765,"line":58,"pdf_page":1,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory;
